product_app.description: Scoped model-audit application with explicit research and customer-production boundaries.
product_app.heading: Atlas Model Audit
product_app.summary: Atlas is the interactive application for running and reviewing scoped model audits. This same-route summary is visible before the application hydrates.
statements: Research verdicts do not establish customer-production ACCEPT.
Individual audit results may be FLAG_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW and require a qualified person to decide next steps.
Evidence is present only when a named artifact passes its contract; otherwise that evidence is unavailable.
Capabilities and results remain scoped to the named model, method, dataset, and run. No compliance certification or universal safety conclusion is asserted.

audit_console.description: Run and inspect a scoped model audit with explicit evidence and human-review boundaries.
audit_console.heading: Audit Console
audit_console.summary: Use the Audit Console to start and inspect a scoped model audit. The interactive controls load after this same-route summary hydrates.
statements: An audit verdict of ACCEPT applies only to its named research validation; it does not establish customer-production ACCEPT.
Audit findings may be FLAG_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW and require a qualified person to decide next steps.
Evidence is present only when a named artifact passes its contract; otherwise that evidence is unavailable.
The console reports scoped evidence, not a compliance certification or a universal safety conclusion.
